title: WBJEE 2025 Result To Be Announced Soon, Check Latest Update, Official Website
text:
WBJEE 2025 Result To Be Announced Soon, Check Latest Update, Official Website
WBJEE 2025 results will be made available at wbjeeb.nic.in. Students will be able to check their results by logging with application number and password.
WBJEE Result 2025 Date And Time: The West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board (WBJEEB) will soon announce the WBJEE 2025 results on its official website at wbjeeb.nic.in. Candidates can check and download their WBJEE 2025 results by logging in with their application number and password.
Those who qualify in the WBJEE 2025 exam will be eligible to participate in the counselling process. This counselling will include steps like registration, filling in choices of colleges and courses, seat allotment, reporting to allotted institutions, and other related procedures. Only candidates who have a valid WBJEE 2025 score can take part in the counselling.

How To Check And Download WBJEE Results 2025?
To check and download the WBJEE 2025 results, candidates should follow these steps:
Step 1: Visit the official website of WBJEEB at wbjeeb.nic.in.
Step 2: Click on the link for WBJEE Results 2025.
Step 3: A new page will open. Now, enter your login details, such as application number and password.
Step 4: Your WBJEE result will appear on the screen.
Step 5: Download the result PDF and print it out for future reference.
WBJEE Results 2025: Details Included
The WBJEE 2025 scorecard will contain the following details:
Candidate’s Name
Roll Number
Rank secured in WBJEE 2025
Total marks obtained
Marks scored in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics individually
Date of Birth
Category
Application Number
Gender

WBJEE Result 2025: Merit List
Candidates whose names appear on the merit list must attend the WBJEE 2025 counselling sessions. The General Merit List will be used for all rounds of counselling. Additionally, merit lists based on categories such as SC, ST, OBC, and others will also be published. The merit lists are prepared using the scores candidates have earned in each subject of the WBJEE 2025 exam.
This process helps ensure that students are fairly ranked and placed based on their performance in the exam.
